walls.reference_basis: North-row top dimension chain on 1f_view.png (1240/2400/1300/1240/2400/1240/1300/2400/1240mm, header total 15000mm) contains an explicit dimension-line break/jog mark (double diagonal tick) exactly at the cumulative 4940mm point, which coincides with this partition's modeled x=4.94m centerline. The nine printed segment labels sum to only 14760mm, i.e. 240mm less than the stated 15000mm total; this missing 240mm is hidden at the two jog marks (this wall and the x=9.82m partition), consistent with wall-thickness zones the drafter chose not to letter individually. The per-wall share of that 240mm is not determinable from this evidence, so thickness is left unknown rather than assumed; the representative plane stays at the seed's x=4.94m (unchanged geometry).

walls.reference_basis: Explicit 240 thickness callout with extension ticks spans the wall band on 1f_view.png near x~655-700 px, matching the measured solid gray fill width (~20px) at multiple clear locations along this facade (e.g. x=770-830 px, y=347-367 px). The overall 8000mm vertical dimension north extension tick (~y=343px) aligns with the OUTER (smaller-pixel-y) face of this band, and representative plane y=8.0m is the footprint outer boundary, so offset 0 (outer face) is taken as representative; the inner face is at offset -0.24m. Note: pixel-derived scale (~10.6mm/px from the 15000mm chain) gives ~213mm for the measured 20px band, reasonably consistent with the printed 240 label within drawing/measurement tolerance; the printed label value (240mm) is used as the persisted thickness.

data.scope: agent-supplied geometry to independent source BIM; no correction run or solver stage

source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: Plan top edge = North, bottom edge = South, left = West, right = East (unchanged from seed).
Wall thickness ~0.24m generally per plan hatch/jamb annotations; modeled as zero-thickness representative planes at wall centerlines/faces as previously established; not globally revised this pass.

F1 north-row partitions at x=4.94m and x=9.82m are confirmed this pass to sit exactly at dimension-chain break/jog points where 240mm of the stated 15000mm total is omitted from the printed labels; representative planes are kept unchanged (seed values) since the per-wall split of that 240mm is not evidenced.

A separate west-margin vs east-margin vertical dimension-chain conflict for the F1 corridor partitions (y=3/y=5) was found in a prior step this pass: west chain (3000/250/1500/250/3000=8000mm) closes exactly to the 8000mm footprint; east chain (2940/340/1200/340/2940=7760mm) does not (-240mm residual) and gives a different flank reading (340 vs 250mm). This was recorded as a textual finding; a structured wall_references entry for that boundary was attempted but rejected by the tool as a partial multi-room shared-wall contact, so it is documented here in notes instead, with representative planes left unchanged.
unresolved: F1 partitions at x=4.94m and x=9.82m: individual thickness/offset unresolved; only the aggregate 240mm gap across both jogs is evidenced.

F1 corridor partition walls (y=3/y=5): west-chain vs east-chain readings conflict (250mm vs 340mm flank, 8000mm vs 7760mm closure); true thickness/offset unresolved, geometry left at seed position; could not be persisted as a structured wall_reference because the corridor boundary is a partial multi-room shared wall unsupported by this tool.
The same east-margin chain also reads room heights as 2940mm vs the west chain's 3000mm; not further investigated this pass.

2f_view.png overlay calibration (~2.7% cross-axis disagreement), F1 north-row window span residuals, F1 east window sill/head height residual, and F2 ConfA/ConfB door split remain unresolved as carried over from the prior round.
Door swing direction/leaf count and room role labels remain unresolved as before.

Only these two F1 north-row partitions and the F1 corridor partitions were examined for the dimension-endpoint/reference-plane relationship this pass; all other interior and exterior wall faces on F1 and all of F2 remain unexamined for the same kind of chain-break ambiguity.
